title: Согласовать operation budget, worker timeout, retry_after, lease и shutdown grace
summary: Исправить A7 по каждой pipeline stage и доказать real-worker поведением, что штатная длинная операция успевает/checkpoint-requeue до supervisor kill без concurrent redelivery. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/artifacts-PARSING_PRODUCTION_ACCEPTANCE.json:195-218`).
why: Prepare 120s против OCR 1800s, screening 60s против LLM 150s+poll, extraction checkpoint 240s перед новым 150s call против timeout 300s; direct `handle()` этого не видит. RAG:✅ 2026-09-10 — Laravel Horizon timeout ordering сохранён в `@plan/knowledge/findings-00-source-synthesis.json`.

include: explicit budget matrix for prepare/screening/extraction; maximum next-call reserve; job/supervisor timeout, connection `retry_after`, analysis/job lease and `stopwaitsecs`/shutdown grace; separate/checkpointed OCR lane if required; deterministic config invariant tests; real Redis/Horizon slow-success, near-deadline checkpoint, SIGTERM/SIGKILL recovery and no-overlap script.
exclude: arbitrary global timeout increase; performance SLA; changing model/provider; accepting 30-minute monolithic job without checkpoint/retry proof.

rules: For every stage: `max single call + persistence/release reserve <= remaining job budget`, `job timeout < supervisor timeout < retry_after`, lease covers intended active slice and is released/recovered, shutdown grace is not shorter than graceful completion/checkpoint path. OCR must either get a compatible lane or bounded child/checkpoint behavior. Effective production config is captured, not inferred from test defaults. RAG:✅ 2026-09-10 — Laravel Horizon rule cited in audit/acceptance.
guidance: Extend `QueueTimeoutInvariantTest` with the maximum next-call reserve and every connection/supervisor mapping. Real-worker contract launches actual Redis/Horizon jobs with controllable slow doubles, observes PID/job state, sends SIGTERM then SIGKILL in separate cases, and reconciles output/state before verdict. Assert no two workers hold the same analysis/job lease. Do not sleep for production-length time in PHPUnit; use small test-profile budgets with identical inequalities. Preserve unrelated dirty compose/config hunks surgically.
